{{Short description|Differential graded algebra}}
{{refimprove|date=May 2021}}

In [[mathematics]], the '''Cartan model''' is a [[differential graded algebra]] that computes the [[equivariant cohomology]] of a [[topological space|space]].

==References==
* Stefan Cordes, Gregory Moore, Sanjaye Ramgoolam, ''Lectures on 2D Yang-Mills Theory, Equivariant Cohomology and Topological Field Theories'', {{arxiv|hep-th/9411210}}, 1994.
